title: MJ-12 scientists really were involved
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of MJ-12 scientists really were involved, about late 1940s-1950s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: these scientists who were supposedly in the Majestic 12 group, if that was even its real name, that's all nonsense. It's just San Freriedman made the whole thing up." That's not true. They were involved.

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber talks about Majestic 12, a name found in documents that describe a secret group of scientists and officials said to have handled UFO matters in the late 1940s and 1950s. Some people say a researcher named Stanton Friedman made the whole thing up, but Strieber says that is not true and that the scientists named, including a mathematician named John von Neumann, really were involved, even if the group's name was not real. If so, top American scientists would have been working on UFOs in secret from the start.
